absences: No vendor milestone dated on or after 2026-11-11 was found in any fetched or snippet source, for shipped or non-table vendors. Items: none.

No shipped vendor value was contradicted by a fetched page dated 2026. Checks: none. Oklo's 'deployment at INL in 2027' headline is from a POWER article dated 2025-03-20 and does not contradict the shipped 2028 startup target.

Westinghouse eVinci: first_delivery_target is None. Search snippets say the prototype is slated for DOME in 2027-2028, but a 2025-07-03 POWER article is the only fetched page, and it does not give a delivery date. The 2026 NRIC call says Westinghouse declined the 2027 DOME slot. No firm customer delivery date found.

General Atomics GA-TES at Fort Hood: no delivery or operation date published. The Army targets at least one operating microreactor by 2028-09-30 across all five vendors, and does not expect all five to meet it. Only search snippets were read; the GA press release was not fetched.
Antares Fort Bragg (three R1, Janus): snippet-only report of a 2028-09-30 fully-operational requirement. The Businesswire Janus release (2026-08-26) was not fetched.

Deployable Energy Unity-1: full-power DOME test is 2027 with no month. NRIC's call says the next DOME slot begins July 2027. Unity reached zero-power criticality 2026-06-30 (before the window). No dated 2026-11-11+ event found.

Last Energy PWR-5 (Texas A&M RELLIS): September 2026 coverage says criticality is 'months away'. No dated event found after 2026-11-10. Last Energy's DSA approval (2026-10-07) is already shipped in skip/news.json.

NANO Nuclear KRONOS MMR and ZEUS: no 2026 dated event found after 2026-11-10. Search returned 2025 and earlier items plus an undated ZEUS 1:2 scale core-hardware assembly and an undated ODIN letter of intent.
Aalo-0 commissioning: company says 'fall 2026' with no date. Aalo is in recently-checked, so no check was attempted.
Natura MSR-1: FLiBe salt reached Abilene 2026-09-18 (before the window). Fuel loading and criticality are undated, and DOE safety-framework status is conflicting across sources.
Not searched within this pass: Blue Energy, Terra Innovatum, Steady Energy (non-table 1-20 MWe designs). Outside the budget for this run; listed as a gap, not as a finding.
